title: Square-face diagonal subdivision with local common-core control
proposed_by: TECT research programme under operator directive

parent.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned researcher-owned geometric successor. It supplements, but does not edit, supersede or retroactively complete PAH-001, PAH-OMC-001 or PAH-OMC-003.

local_incidence_witness.incidence_change: One square face is replaced by two triangular faces and one diagonal edge is added; the new diagonal carries an independent Z_K link variable.

strip_family.faces: For i<n, q_i is replaced by triangles [h_i^0,v_(i+1),d_i^(-1)] and [d_i,(h_i^1)^(-1),v_i^(-1)]; q_n remains the unsplit square with its oriented boundary.
strip_family.anchors: O={(0,0)} and C={(0,1)}; the audited anchor-preserving automorphism group is the identity.

exact_scope.state_and_regulator: Use the unchanged PAH-001 integer aperture, phase, radial and Z_K link variables on the displayed carrier. The finite audit fixes K=2, M_s=M_psi=1, Q=0, epsilon=1/2, beta=1, nu=1, R_max=1, m2=0, lambda_4=1, eta_6=1, g=1, lambda_s=1, kappa_s=1, kappa_D=1, kappa_g=1, theta=0. Q=0 is a finite scope restriction, so all nonnegative radial levels vanish; it is not a physical-sector assertion.
exact_scope.functional: F_rho is exactly the displayed PAH-001 functional: vertex aperture/matter terms, edge aperture stiffness, covariant matter edge term and plaquette Wilson term with J_e(s)=2/(s_v+s_w) and J_p the boundary average. No term, coupling, weight or counterterm is added.
exact_scope.moves_and_rates: Use the unchanged PAH move families and inverse convention. In the Q=0 witness, radial transfers are absent because the fixed nonnegative charge sector has all ell_v=0; phase roots have zero matter contribution. Aperture and link roots retain c_r(x)=m_r(x) exp(-beta(F_r x-F x)/2), with m_r from the parent mobility rule and no rate fitting.
exact_scope.time: External stochastic Markov time only; no quantum, proper or Lorentzian interpretation.
exact_scope.limit_label: a_n=a_0/2^n is a refinement label only. No cutoff, physical-volume or continuum limit is taken.

maps_and_parameters.one_step_projection: p_(n+1,n) retains all old vertex apertures, phases and old edge links, and drops the new diagonal d_n and new column n+2 variables. It is total on the declared Q=0 states.
maps_and_parameters.root_transport: Old vertex and old-edge roots are retained with their PAH labels; the new diagonal and new-column roots are vertical. A root changing only dropped variables has zero action on an old cylinder observable.
maps_and_parameters.observable_lift: (I_n f)(x)=f(p x). The common core is the algebraic union of bounded gauge- and anchor-automorphism-invariant cylinder functions with finite column support.
maps_and_parameters.parameter_transport: K,Q,M_s,M_psi,R_max,epsilon,beta,nu,theta and every displayed coupling are inherited identically. Only the formal label a_n=a_0/2^n changes.
maps_and_parameters.normalization: Counting measure on each finite state space and the unchanged PAH Gibbs rate normalization; no conditional Gibbs averaging is used.
maps_and_parameters.common_norm: delta_n(f)=||L_(n+1) I_n f-I_n L_n f||_infinity over the finite fine state space.

compatibility_target.local_eventual_exactness: If the interaction closure of f is contained in columns 0,...,m, then delta_n(f)=0 for every n>m because the q_n split and the newly added column are outside the local rate support of f.
compatibility_target.finite_cumulative_bound: For any bounded cylinder f, with N_f aperture/link roots that can change f, delta_n(f)<=4 N_f exp(beta D_local/2)||f||_infinity on affected levels and delta_n(f)=0 eventually; hence sum_n delta_n(f) is finite.
compatibility_target.local_energy_envelope: D_local is computed from the PAH terms on the declared Q=0 slice as onsite_range + degree_bound*edge_range + face_incidence_bound*face_range. The script derives all three ranges from epsilon and the exact local formulas.
compatibility_target.scope_statement: This is local common-core compatibility with a finite cumulative bound, not a global uniform estimate over all observables, volumes, regulators, phases or source choices.

finite_witness.state: All aperture levels j_v=0 and all old links u_e=0; the fine diagonal link is u_d=0 or u_d=1.
finite_witness.observable: f=s_0, a bounded gauge- and anchor-invariant aperture cylinder.
finite_witness.aperture_move: Raise j_0 from 0 to 1 with s_v=1/2+j_v/2.
finite_witness.derived_values: The exact PAH energy increments are Delta F_coarse=1/8, Delta F_fine(u_d=0)=1/4 and Delta F_fine(u_d=1)=-55/36. The aperture mobility is sqrt(1/2) and its square is 1/2, so the corresponding rate factors are sqrt(1/2)exp(-1/16), sqrt(1/2)exp(-1/8) and sqrt(1/2)exp(55/72).
finite_witness.interpretation: The nonzero hidden-diagonal dependence is an explicit boundary defect for a split intersecting the observable; it is not used as a global no-go.

finite_acceptance_conditions: The PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001 parent hashes match exactly and neither parent is edited.
The local witness changes edge and face incidence and introduces a genuine diagonal link, not a colour label or duplicated transition rate.
The strip projection, root transport, Q=0 sector and parameter transport are total and explicitly enumerated.
The primary script derives the exact PAH energy increments, mobility, local energy envelope, incidence counts and eventual-zero rule.
The non-importing independent script reproduces the witness and locality bound from direct formulas.
The hostile script rejects source drift, colour-only substitution, added terms, rate fitting, wrong topology, wrong projection, wrong Q sector and physical promotion.
Lean checks the rational witness, the incidence change, the eventual-zero/cumulative implication and the non-promotion firewall.

known_boundaries.affected_levels: The local square split need not intertwine exactly when it meets the observable support; the explicit diagonal-link witness has nonzero defect.
known_boundaries.local_not_global: Eventual exactness holds for each fixed finite-support cylinder along this strip family. A supremum over all observables or a volume-uniform generator estimate is not proved.
known_boundaries.q_zero_scope: Q=0 removes matter and radial-transfer activity in the audited fixture. This is a finite diagnostic slice, not a production-sector or physical-vacuum result.
known_boundaries.no_continuum: The geometric incidence family is an anchored strip refinement/exhaustion label, not a proof of a->0 continuum convergence or a physical lattice spacing.

falsifiers: Any parent hash or parent byte changes.
The local carrier does not change edge/face incidence or the diagonal link is only a colour label.
The exact PAH energy formula, orientations, mobility or rate convention is changed, weighted, counterterm-repaired or post-hoc fitted.
The projection is not total on the fixed-Q state space or a root changing a retained observable is silently dropped.
The independent lane fails to reproduce the exact witness or the eventual-zero locality condition.
The derived local energy envelope fails on a finite strip template or the cumulative bound is asserted without its root-count and support hypotheses.
The result is promoted to a global uniform limit, physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE theorem.
non_claims: PAH-OMC-004 is a researcher-proposed successor, not an external source or physical authority.
The finite theorem concerns PAH-001 composed with PAH-OMC-001 and this separately hashed geometric successor; it is not retroactive evidence for PAH-001 alone.
The local eventual-zero statement is not a global volume-, regulator-, source- or phase-uniform estimate and does not close an ordered limit.
Q=0 is a finite test sector and is not the physical vacuum or a Reading-H construction.
Markov time is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
single_next_question: Can the local eventual-exactness and finite cumulative bound be extended from the Q=0 strip diagnostic to a source-authorized nonzero-Q family with a uniform interaction-closure estimate, without altering PAH-001?
revisit_condition: Reopen a broader or physical refinement route only after a separately hashed owner contract supplies nonzero-Q state transport, source-authorized root multiplicities, a common invariant core and a uniform estimate in the declared limit order.
stop_or_redesign: Keep the explicit nonzero local boundary defect; do not erase it by averaging, a counterterm or rate rescaling.
If the independent locality proof fails, retain only the exact finite incidence witness and mark the successor HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
If a global uniform estimate is requested, create a new contract with its own assumptions rather than upgrading this local theorem.
Do not use this result to assert physical vacuum, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills or continuum closure.
